name: Production Multi-Agent Autonomous Software Engineer & Code Architect
architectural_class: Production Hierarchical Multi-Agent Software Development System
reference_media: Claude Code Multi-Agent Orchestration with Opus, Tmux and Agent Sandboxes (IndyDevDan)
Building Autonomous AI Software Engineers in LangGraph (Dave Ebbelaar)

vibe_coding_failures: Context window contamination and token blowout from loading whole repositories
Host pollution and blast radius risks from uncontained script execution
Absence of empirical verification and runtime stack trace feedback
Infinite hallucination loops modifying identical lines without root cause discovery
problem_solved.solution_mechanism: Autonomous TDD Red-Green-Audit loop with context-isolated agents and ephemeral execution sandboxes

stack_components.sandboxing: Ephemeral Subprocess / Docker Containers / E2B Cloud Sandboxes
stack_components.testing_engine: Python Unittest / Pytest / Isolated Traceback Sanitizer
stack_components.static_analysis: Python AST Security Auditor / Ruff / Semgrep

agent_roles.title: Lead Architect & Planner Agent
agent_roles.context_boundary: High-level directory structure, interfaces, issue text. Strictly prohibited from writing implementation code.
deliverables: Acceptance criteria and reproduction test requirements

agent_roles.title: Coder & Implementer Agent
agent_roles.context_boundary: Isolated context containing only target source file, issue spec, and failing stack traces.
deliverables: Root cause hypotheses and correction edits

agent_roles.title: Test Runner Sandbox Agent
agent_roles.context_boundary: Isolated ephemeral directory or container. Zero access to host OS files.
deliverables: Exit codes and test status badges

agent_roles.title: Critic & Security Auditor Agent
agent_roles.context_boundary: Unified git diff and AST parse trees. Evaluated with adversarial senior engineer lens.

agent_roles.title: Git Tooling & Release Agent
agent_roles.context_boundary: Repository lifecycle, git diff, and test receipts.
deliverables: Enterprise-grade Pull Request with empirical TDD proof

tdd_state_machine.red_phase: Coder writes reproduction test; Sandbox executes test on unpatched code to prove bug existence via non-zero exit code.
tdd_state_machine.green_phase: Coder crafts surgical patch; Sandbox re-executes test suite until all assertions pass (exit code 0).
tdd_state_machine.audit_phase: Critic inspects git diff and runs AST security checks against hardcoded secrets and dangerous calls.
tdd_state_machine.release_phase: Git agent commits changes to a feature branch and formats production PR markdown with before/after receipts.
